product_updates.title: Google releases Gemini 4 Argon, called its most powerful model yet
product_updates.content: Google has released its latest Gemini model, marketing it as a workhorse for coding and cybersecurity work.

product_updates.title: Valor, Atreides, and Sequoia back AI startup Flow Engineering at $750M valuation
product_updates.content: Flow Engineering, which is bringing AI agents to hardware design, also landed Roelof Botha as an angel investor and board member.

product_updates.title: OpenAI’s Jev clone could help the frontier lab stop its swarming agents
product_updates.content: OpenAI's "Decisions API" is a Jev clone that confirms the importance of fast, cheap intelligence.

product_updates.title: AI voice startup ElevenLabs doubles valuation to $22B
product_updates.content: The $300 million employee tender was co-led by Wellington and T. Rowe Price.

product_updates.title: Reddit is killing RSS feeds and ending public API access because of AI bots
product_updates.content: Reddit is ending support for RSS feeds, as the company continues tightening access to its trove of user-generated content.

product_updates.title: The ugly economics of consumer AI
product_updates.content: There’s a reason frontier labs have gotten gun-shy about consumer AI — and it’s not because the tech isn’t good enough.

product_updates.title: Meta disputes claim that Muse read a user’s private messages without permission
product_updates.content: Meta says its Muse AI agent cannot access a user’s Messages without explicit permission, disputing a journalist’s account that the agent read his private messages while the required Mac setting was turned off.

product_updates.title: DoorDash launches an AI agent you can text to order food
product_updates.content: By launching an AI agent for food ordering, DoorDash is looking to gain an edge over rivals Uber Eats and Grubhub.

product_updates.title: Destro AI’s secret sauce is getting robots and humans on the same page
product_updates.content: "One of the biggest reasons we are winning against robotics companies is because we are not a robotics company."

product_updates.title: Instinct’s new product recommendations are giving some users the ick
product_updates.content: Instinct is rolling out human-curated product and travel recommendations, but some users aren’t happy about getting suggestions they never asked for.

technical_breakthroughs.title: Attackers have been exploiting critical Zimbra flaw to steal emails
technical_breakthroughs.content: A simple email gives the attackers the ability to remotely inject OS commands.
